preconditions.description: The road width n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The number of safety islands m is between 2 and the minimum of n+1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d_i <= n for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: Each safety island coordinate d_i is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 0 in d and n in d
preconditions.description: Safety islands are located at the beginning (0) and the end (n) of the road.
All safety island coordinates are distinct.
The green light duration g is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The red light duration r is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (impossible to cross) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum time to cross the road.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value % (g + r) <= g or return_value % (g + r) == 0)
postconditions.description: If it is possible to cross the road, the output time is such that Denis can only move during green light periods.
